STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - All styling lives in `style.css`. Derive an "ink" variant for every pastel (e.g., `--primary-ink` ≈ `#1a5e8a`, `--secondary-ink` ≈ `#9c2f44`, success ink ≈ `#1e6b34`) that meets **4.5:1** against its paired surface. Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token — enforced in both themes, not just the default. - **Light backgrounds:** `--bg-primary` is a soft blue-tinted off-white (e.g., `#eef2f7`); `--bg-secondary` is `#fefefe`. Never use `#ffffff`. - **Dark mode:** `--bg-primary` is a soft dark slate (e.g., `#1c2333`, never pure black); `--bg-secondary` is an elevated surface (e.g., `#263042`). Pastels may serve directly as accent/text colors on dark surfaces only where they pass 4.5:1 (Soft Blue `#87CEEB` qualifies; verify or brighten pink/green before using them as text). - **Radii:** `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 12px` (stay within 8–12px). - **Shadows (theme signature — softer than flat, clearer than pure neumorphism):** multi-layer soft shadows, e.g., `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,32,51,.06), 0 2px 8px rgba(23,32,51,.06)` and `--shadow-md: 0 2px 4px rgba(23,32,51,.07), 0 10px 28px rgba(23,32,51,.10)`. An optional `--shadow-lg` may be defined for hero and popular-tier elevation. Dark mode overrides shadows with deeper, subtler values. Hard neumorphic dual-light embossing that destroys contrast is forbidden. - **Spacing & motion:** `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 200ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)`. - **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast` (header uses `--z-dropdown`; reserve the others to prevent overlap conflicts between layered components). ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support - Dark tokens must be defined both under a `.dark` class and via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` as the first-paint/no-JS source of truth; `script.js` then applies the `.dark` class from the stored preference as early as possible (top of file, before all other logic) to minimize any flash. - The header contains a visible theme toggle (Material Symbols sun/moon) with correct `aria-pressed` and a dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). - The user's choice persists in `localStorage`; first visit falls back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Background and text variables must swap seamlessly with no HTML restructuring. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - Build all layout structure with Flexbox. Every flex container **defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., card content stacks: `flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start`). - Mobile-first: multi-column rows collapse to single columns on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px upward. ### 1.5 Framework & Naming Convention - Use clean, framework-free custom CSS (the permitted alternative to Tailwind for this heavily token-driven theme).
